label: copy phase: input 3 fed back, about to output c (bigram 3 c), recall position >= 3
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, on the step where the copied-back input is the digit 3 and the next output is c, i.e. the model is reproducing an original bigram "3 c". The top activations (up to 2.86) are all of this kind, the strongest when 3 sits at original position 2-4 and is followed by "c c". It is silent for recall_idx 0-1 and nearly silent at 2, so the predicate requires recall_idx >= 3, which lifts dev precision to 0.92 (recall 0.54, mass recall 0.77). The misses are a weak tail (about 21% of mass): input 3 followed by a different output (3 3, 3 o, 3 r), input c followed by c (the step after 3 c c, ~0.1-0.2), and small activations. It never fires in the original or delimiter phases, or on tokens other than 3 and c. Magnitude goes up with an early-middle recall position and when c is repeated; the low-quartile examples are mostly 3 c late in long sequences or 3 followed by a non-c token.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=3 (+7.38), in_tok=3 (+4.75), phase=2 & out_tok=c (+4.51), next_out=c (+4.47), out_tok=c (+4.21), phase=2 & in_tok=c (+3.95). Lower it: correct=1 (-5.52), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.27), recall_idx=1 (-3.27), to_go=6 (-2.24).
